images.title: Spending more than the balance
images.purpose: Show a balance of 130 falling to 0 and then 20 below zero after a debit of 150.
images.composition: One tall vertical number line centred, with a short label on each side, wide margins.
images.exact_structure: One vertical line with 16 evenly spaced tick marks, from 130 at the top down to −20 at the bottom, one tick for every 10, with the tick for 0 drawn as a longer line. A teal #0072B2 arrow runs down from the 130 tick to the 0 tick (13 gaps). A reddish purple #CC79A7 arrow continues from the 0 tick to the −20 tick (2 gaps). Exactly 2 arrows, 1 line.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a teal arrow that does not end exactly on the 0 tick
images.takeaway: A debit bigger than the balance takes it below zero, to a negative balance.
images.description: A vertical line from 130 down to −20 with a teal arrow from 130 to 0 and a purple arrow from 0 to −20, showing 130 − 150 = −20.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to say where the balance reaches 0 and how much of the debit is still left.

image_decisions.why: A balance dropping past zero is a picture idea; one clean vertical line carries it.
